references.title: Benchmarking Zero-shot Text Classification: Datasets, Evaluation and Entailment Approach
references.role: Definition-anchored / entailment-based zero-shot classification — the method behind repair R1.
Vocabulary control for information retrieval — the 50-year settlement that curated corpora want controlled vocabularies.

references.venue: Journal of the American Society for Information Science
references.role: Natural language versus controlled vocabulary in retrieval — the finding is context-dependent; Maxwell OS is the curated case.

references.title: The Behavior Change Technique Taxonomy (v1) of 93 Hierarchically Clustered Techniques: Building an International Consensus for the Reporting of Behavior Change Interventions
references.role: BCTTv1 — the authoritative analogue: 93 consensus-built labels, published per-label reliability, a coding manual, mandatory training. Maxwell OS's RULER_MENUS is its coding manual.

references.title: Evaluating ontological decisions with OntoClean
references.role: OntoClean (rigidity / identity / unity / dependence) — the test for why 'typography' is applicable and 'cultural design' is not.

references.title: A Coefficient of Agreement for Nominal Scales
references.role: Cohen's kappa — the agreement coefficient for per-slot reliability.

references.title: The Measurement of Observer Agreement for Categorical Data
references.role: Landis & Koch — the 0.61 'substantial' threshold adopted as the per-slot acceptance gate.

references.title: Content Analysis: An Introduction to Its Methodology
references.role: Content analysis — the reliability framework for human coding; also the source of the 'no spotless without a number' discipline.
references.note: EDITION NOTE: the 4th edition (2019) is cited; the work originates in 1980 and this DOI is the SAGE edition.

references.title: Slug Expression Enhances Tumor Formation in a Noninvasive Rectal Cancer Model
references.role: OQuaRE — SQuaRE-based ontology quality metrics (cohesion, completeness, consistency).
W3C SHACL — the machine-checkable shape contract. config/taxonomy_shacl.ttl already exists in this repo and is unenforced.
W3C SKOS — prefLabel / altLabel / scopeNote; the authority-control vocabulary for one preferred label plus variants.

references.title: Confident Learning: Estimating Uncertainty in Dataset Labels
references.role: Confident Learning / cleanlab — ranks likely-mislabeled rows from existing features and labels, no LLM, fully local.
references.bears: F-C, the cheap replacement for sample-only auditing

references.title: Snorkel: rapid training data creation with weak supervision.
references.role: Snorkel — weak supervision: many cheap labelling functions combined with learned accuracies. The principled successor to a 999-rule alias table.
references.note: VERSION NOTE: the VLDB Journal article (2020) supersedes the 2017 arXiv preprint; cite the journal version.

references.title: TRUE: Re-evaluating Factual Consistency Evaluation
references.venue: Proceedings of the 2022 Conference of the North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Human Language Technologies
references.role: TRUE — NLI-based factual-consistency scorers correlate weakly with human judgement. This is the citation that forbids reading an S5 NEUTRAL as FALSE.

references.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
references.role: Selective classification — abstain by an explicit risk/coverage trade-off rather than an arbitrary threshold.
references.note: arXiv identifier: the NeurIPS 2017 version is the citable one; the arXiv record has the lower citation count (OpenAlex does not merge them).

references.title: A Gentle Introduction to Conformal Prediction and Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification
references.role: Conformal prediction — distribution-free guarantees; how to choose the S5 threshold with a stated error budget.

references.title: Relevance: A review of the literature and a framework for thinking on the notion in information science. Part II: nature and manifestations of relevance
references.venue: Journal of the American Society for Information Science and Technology
references.role: Relevance is RELATIONAL (document x user x goal), not an intrinsic property of text. The theoretical basis for a separate, revisable relevance axis.

references.title: QuRating: Selecting High-Quality Data for Training Language Models
references.role: QuRating — quality as explicit human-rated criteria plus a trained local judge. The template for turning 'valid fact but irrelevant' into named, ratable criteria.

references.title: The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at Scale
references.role: FineWeb / FineWeb-Edu — a classifier trained on a small labelled set beats regex heuristics for 'is this valuable'.
references.bears: F-E, and the stage1.3 prefilter's limits

references.title: Task, Information Seeking Intentions, and User Behavior
references.role: Personal Knowledge Graphs — the closest architectural frame: user-scoped, privacy-bound, non-canonical, assumes personal relevance and personal vocabulary drift.

references.title: ACORN: Performant and Predicate-Agnostic Search Over Vector Embeddings and Structured Data
references.venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data
references.role: ACORN — predicate-agnostic filtered vector search. The design conclusion that a facet meant to PARTITION must constrain every candidate generator, before truncation.
references.bears: F-28 / BUG-285 / D273a (the filters do not filter)

references.title: Dense X Retrieval: What Retrieval Granularity Should We Use?
references.role: Dense X Retrieval — retrieval GRANULARITY: finer self-contained units beat passages, but the unit must stay self-contained.

references.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
references.role: DPR — passage-level dense retrieval; the baseline for what 'a retrieval unit' means.

references.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
references.role: ColBERT — late interaction over token-level units; the finer-grained alternative to a single pooled vector.

references.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
references.venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics
references.role: Lost in the Middle — more context is not better context. Why returning the matched segment with its parent beats returning everything.

references.title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
references.venue: Foundations and Trends® in Information Retrieval
references.role: BM25 / probabilistic relevance — the ranking function under the FTS leg; the reference for keyword-leg weighting in fusion.

references.title: Reciprocal rank fusion outperforms condorcet and individual rank learning methods
references.role: Reciprocal Rank Fusion — the ORIGINAL RRF paper. search_hybrid already implements Score(d)=sum 1/(k+rank) with k=60, so this is the reference for the fusion that already exists, not a change.

references.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey
references.role: RAG survey — the landscape and the standard component decomposition.

references.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
references.role: RGB — noise robustness is the dominant RAG failure mode. Wilson OS has NO retrieval benchmark; this is why one is required.

references.title: Implementing faceted classification for software reuse
references.role: Faceted classification for software reuse — the canonical demonstration that small orthogonal controlled facets scale, and that facets MUST be orthogonal.

references.title: A Survey on Truth Discovery
references.role: Truth discovery — jointly estimate source reliability and claim truth from agreement, no ground truth needed. The missing implementation behind an empty contradicts_fbs.

references.title: On the resemblance and containment of documents
